title: CSUDH Math Teachers’ Circle Session Database

method.scope: All 77 academic-year session folders and identifiable named Summer Institute sessions or activities. Routine breaks, meals, check-ins, unnamed warmups, and collaborative lesson planning/sharing are excluded from the session catalog. Participant-created lessons remain in the resource inventory.
method.dates: Dates come from flyers, agendas, slide title pages, or dated folder names, never file creation or modification timestamps. Flyers establish advertised dates, not proof that a meeting took place. Institute windows do not identify an individual session day. Conflicts and partial dates are flagged.
method.descriptions: Short descriptions and controlled topic tags are editorial summaries of source materials, not original supplied metadata. Agenda-only or inferred descriptions are identified in offering notes.
method.repeat_sessions: Matching sessions are consolidated across years. Combined sessions remain intact (for example, 4-Game Night); their individual activities are searchable as tags. Exploding Dots Parts 1–2 are one two-part offering.
method.resources: 586 resource files are inventoried. Unassigned resources retain their archive paths.
method.session_folders: Every session and offering has a resource folder URL. The session-level primary URL points to the most recent offering. All dated folder links are retained in Offerings and in each session’s resource_folders array; resource_folder_urls lists the distinct folders.
method.maintenance: The spreadsheet is the master. This file was generated by the browser export tool. Session summaries are recalculated from Offerings; existing IDs are preserved.
